entry.title: New: dsh-sxs-anti-bot-http
entry.summary: Anti-bot HTTP fetch tools hardened by SXS's production scraping stack (millions of requests/day): UA-pool rotation, retry with exponential backoff, anti-bot wall detection (captcha / verification challenges) and adaptive rate limiting — tools: `sxs_fetch` / `sxs_fetch_json` / `sxs_rate_status`. Exact install spec: github:yangyunsong023/dsh-sxs-anti-bot-http. Source event: beancookie/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
